text_block_list.text: And thus, race day arrives—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Showtime at last! Looks like Tannhauser-chan made a full recovery too!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Yes! Sorry for worrying everyone~. Thanks to you all, I'm completely fine!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Time to give it everything! Ei, ei, mun!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Fufu, wonderful fighting spirit~. Just mind the nosebleeds.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Whoops... good point. Inhale— exhale— inhale—.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: ...Spe-chan, holding up alright?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Uuu...! Heart's pounding like crazy...! What do I do with all these nerves...?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Whenever anxiety strikes, visualization helps. Picture the grand buffet that comes with the winner's meal voucher~.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: All-you-can-eat buffet! Mmm... shrimp cocktail and roast beef...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ah! The potato medley dish looked delicious too! Plus the fresh acqua pazza—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Fufu, looks like your composure returned~. Team, let's claim that meal voucher! Today, victory is ours~!

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Ah, envisioning those packed spectator stands makes my artistic soul swell with ecstasy! Is our ensemble prepared?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: U-Um, probably... wait! Waah, I always forget gear, let me double-check everything once more...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Finding our own way to the starting line shouldn't be difficult. I'll head out first.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ah... Ayabe-san!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Um! Thank you so much for joining us! I'm genuinely proud to race on this team alongside you!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...You have leisure to indulge sentimentality? The real contest starts now.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Right! I'll give my absolute utmost! I promise to deliver a performance befitting this squad!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: *Sigh*... Earnest as ever. You carry no need to shoulder excess burdens.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: It isn't a burden. I simply want to deliver momentum that inspires you and the team!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: —I see.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Hark! Ayabe-san, Top Road-san! We depart for the arena! Until we take center stage!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Yes! Let's do our best!

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text: —Beneath radiant springtime skies and immaculate weather, the opening fanfare sounds for the Tracen Academy Inter-Team Triathlon Tournament!

text_block_list.name: Event Commentator
text_block_list.text:
The tournament will be contested by 8 teams with a total of 32 
participants! It seems contestants are currently in waiting area 
inside the academy!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Wooww~! Crowd keeps growing and growing! 
All this excitement... gets my heart pounding so fast!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
There are so many TV cameras! Father said he would cheer 
for me while watching the live broadcast at work.

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, that team over there! What's with all that 
talk about aiming for the special prize?

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... some girls don't look like they have any experience 
at all. Participating in event is fine, but I have a bad hunch~.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Kekeke... Can't wait to see all this buzz 
turn into glorious victory scent! Right on!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Everyone will be completely astounded 
to see me blow past my stamina limits!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Bwahaha!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Fu... Fufufu!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Kita-chan, we can definitely run a great race. Look, even during joint 
practice, you held your own against our upperclassmen.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Ah...! You're right, Dia-chan, we've got this!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: There's no obstacle we can't overcome. So hold your head high!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Heads high, full power! Let's show everyone our run!
